obligations: Retain original six analytic callers if actual public theorem uses standing context: alpha>0, alpha<=beta, V C2, both global Hessian bounds, eta>0, beta*eta<=1.
Finite-dimensional real Euclidean typing; no positive-rank requirement, no strict alpha*eta<1.
Total reflection with R0=I; do not divide by norm zero without zero branch.
Produce gradient continuity internally from C2; no Continuous-gradient caller.
Use actual h=gradV(x)-gradV(xRef), same V/reference and no arbitrary supplied normal.
Bounce preserves momentum norm, including h=0.
Normal inner product has exact negative sign; factor2 is fixed.
Bounce involution uses unchanged x and hence unchanged actual h on second bounce.
Prove joint Borel reflection by total zero/nonzero branching; do not demand global continuous S.
Actual S jointly Borel for all reference and phase inputs; y dependence is trivial if included.
Rate has exact sqrt eta and max(0,inner(p,h)), not eta, abs, square or reversed positive part.
Nonnegative rate and zero-normal vanishing must be internally shown.
Joint continuous actual rate from same gradient, hence Borel; fixed eta, all xRef/x/p.
Energy is half of eta^-1*norm(x-c)^2+normp^2, never the squared product norm.
Energy and optional cap use same c=y-eta*gradV(xRef), not y or arbitrary center.
Bounce preserves this same actual H because it fixes x and normp.
Optional exact energy-to-norm bounds use e=H>=0, or explicitly quantified state H<=E with E>=0; no implicit actual-path identification.
Optional beta-Lipschitz gradient must be internally derived from source C2/global Hessian upper bound; no extra Lipschitz premise.
Optional residual growth and positive-part Cauchy/triangle estimates are internal dependencies.
Optional cap is sqrteta*beta*sqrt(2E)*(sqrt(2etaE)+norm(c-xRef)); statewise cap does not produce actual E0 path theorem.
Inherited harmonic flow source-parent can supply flow conservation/Borel separately; no B21 or 68 sharp-energy dependency is invented.
No arbitrary H/rate/normal/envelope correctness premises replace actual definitions; no provider binder.
Pointwise/Borel conclusions need no integrability caller. Compact deterministic segment rate-integrability is a separate derived edge if requested.
Clock/hazard recursion, path cap, nonexplosion, invariance, terminal kernels, main/errors/cost/Goal remain open.
